understanding.goal_understanding: The goal is to solve each level by moving the selectable piece(s) so that every goal tile marked with a '+' is occupied by a selectable piece at the same time. When all goals are covered simultaneously, the level reports WIN; completing all levels wins the full KA59 run within the per-level step budget.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each turn you issue a CLICK on a target grid coordinate. If a movable/selectable piece is currently selected, it attempts to move to (or toward, depending on the level rules) the clicked location; if the destination/path is blocked by walls/obstacles or an illegal tile, the piece does not move. Some clicks appear to act as pure move commands (no change in selection), while other clicks can change which piece is active if multiple pieces exist (selection is typically by clicking on a piece). Movement is constrained by obstacles and collision rules; a move fails (no position change) when blocked. Steps decrement on every click, successful or not, so efficient targeting and avoiding blocked moves is important.
